proof:
Source: parent proof, Steps 6 and 7 (parent A4(e): images of integer multiplicity currents under dilations are integer multiplicity).
Siblings used: deformation_dilation_calculus (first conjunct) and deformation_dilation_hausdorff.

Conventions.
- ℝ^N := Eucl N and μ := H^k = μHE[k].
- c := ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^k), so c ≠ ∞ and c.toReal = ρ^k.
- φ(x) := ρ • x.
- Assume IsIntegerMultiplicity X. Then there are M, θ, ξ with IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ, ∀ x ∈ M, ∃ j : ℕ, θ x = j, and X(ω) = tauAction k M θ ξ ω for all test ω.
- tauAction k S ϑ ζ ω = ∫_{x ∈ S} ϑ(x)·ζ(x)(ω(x)) dμ. This is a Bochner set integral, equal to 0 when the integrand is not integrable.
- Put M′ := φ(M) = (fun x => ρ • x) '' M, θ′(y) := θ(ρ⁻¹ • y) and ξ′(y) := ξ(ρ⁻¹ • y).
- (★) Since ρ⁻¹ • φ(x) = x (inv_smul_smul₀), θ′(φ x) = θ(x) and ξ′(φ x) = ξ(x) for every x.

Template (optional). These declarations have different frozen types and belong to another DAG branch, so do not cite them. The proofs of Submission.ind_rs_rectifiableTriple_dilation and ind_rs_weightedTangent_dilation are on branch humanize-recursive/gmt-ch06/20261011t144224z-6e4735dbca/root-integrality-weak-limits-a1-integer-density-a1-rescale-a1-triple-image-a1-a1. The proof of Submission.ind_rs_tauAction_dilation is on branch proof-workspace/gmt-ch06/20261011t144224z-6e4735dbca/theorems/solutions/root-integrality-weak-limits-a1-integer-density-a1-rescale-a1-tau-action-a1-c14ddccfbd. Together they carry out steps 1, 4 and 5 below for the map y ↦ r⁻¹(y − x); with x = 0 and r = ρ⁻¹ that map is φ. Auxiliary lemmas need globally unique names.

0. Measure facts. By deformation_dilation_hausdorff N k ρ hρ, φ is a measurable embedding (in particular injective) and MeasurePreserving φ (c·μ) μ. Consequences:
(a) Null sets: if μ(S) = 0 then μ(φ(S)) = 0. Indeed μ(φ S) = (φ_#(c·μ))(φ S) = (c·μ)(φ⁻¹(φ S)) = c·μ(S) = 0. (MeasurePreserving.map_eq; MeasurableEmbedding.map_apply holds for all sets; preimage_image_eq by injectivity; Measure.smul_apply, smul_zero.)
(b) Change of variables: for every g : ℝ^N → ℝ and every S ⊆ ℝ^N, ∫_{φ(S)} g dμ = ∫_S g∘φ d(c·μ) = ρ^k·∫_S g∘φ dμ. (MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_image_emb; (c·μ)|_S = c·(μ|_S) by Measure.restrict_smul; integral_smul_measure; ENNReal.toReal_ofReal with ρ^k ≥ 0.) These identities of Bochner integrals need no integrability hypothesis.
(c) Integrability: g is μ-integrable on φ(S) iff g∘φ is (c·μ)-integrable on S (MeasurePreserving.integrableOn_image).
(d) Restricted measures: φ is measure preserving from c·(μ|_M) to μ|_{M′}. Rewrite c·(μ|_M) = (c·μ)|_M with Measure.restrict_smul, then apply MeasurePreserving.restrict_image_emb. In particular μ|_{M′} = φ_#(c·(μ|_M)).

1. τ change of variables. For every k-form ω, tauAction k M θ ξ (x ↦ ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) = tauAction k M′ θ′ ξ′ ω. Apply 0(b) to g(y) := θ′(y)·ξ′(y)(ω(y)) and S := M, and use (★). The right side is
∫_{φ(M)} g dμ = ρ^k·∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(ρ • x)) dμ(x)
= ∫_M ρ^k·θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(ρ • x)) dμ(x) (integral_const_mul)
= ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ρ^k • ω(ρ • x)) dμ(x) (ξ(x) is linear: map_smul, smul_eq_mul; ring),
which is the left side.

2. Representation of Y. Let ω be a test form. By deformation_dilation_calculus N ρ hρ k (first conjunct), there is a test form η with η(x) = ρ^k • ω(ρ • x) for all x. Thus the underlying form of η is x ↦ ρ^k • ω(ρ • x) (funext). Hence Y(ω) = X(η) (hypothesis) = tauAction k M θ ξ η = tauAction k M′ θ′ ξ′ ω (step 1).

3. Integer values. Each y ∈ M′ is φ(x) with x ∈ M, and θ′(y) = θ(x) = j for some j ∈ ℕ by (★).

4. Weighted tangent transport. If x ∈ ℝ^N, Q is a linear subspace and HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x Q, then HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M′ θ′ (ρ • x) Q.
Definition (SimonGMT Chapter03.Rectifiable): HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k S ϑ p Q means finrank Q = k and, for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ), ∫_{u ∈ blowUpMap p s '' S} f(u)·ϑ(p + s • u) dμ(u) → ϑ(p)·∫_{u ∈ Q} f(u) dμ(u) as s → 0 along 𝓝[>] 0, where blowUpMap p s w = s⁻¹ • (w − p). Write I_f(s) for this integral for (M, θ) at x.
(a) finrank Q = k is part of the hypothesis and is unchanged.
(b) Set identity, for every real s: blowUpMap (ρ • x) s '' M′ = blowUpMap x (ρ⁻¹·s) '' M. For z ∈ M, s⁻¹ • (ρ • z − ρ • x) = (s⁻¹·ρ) • (z − x) = (ρ⁻¹·s)⁻¹ • (z − x) (smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv). This holds also for s = 0, because 0⁻¹ = 0. (Set.image_image, Set.image_congr.)
(c) Weights: θ′(ρ • x + s • u) = θ(ρ⁻¹ • (ρ • x + s • u)) = θ(x + (ρ⁻¹·s) • u) (smul_add, inv_smul_smul₀, smul_smul), and θ′(ρ • x) = θ(x).
(d) By (b) and (c), the integral required for (M′, θ′) at ρ • x with ratio s equals I_f(ρ⁻¹·s). The map s ↦ ρ⁻¹·s is continuous, has value 0 at 0 and maps (0, ∞) into (0, ∞) (mul_pos). So it tends from 𝓝[>] 0 to 𝓝[>] 0 (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff, nhdsWithin_le_nhds, eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall). Composing with the hypothesis (Tendsto.comp, Tendsto.congr) gives I_f(ρ⁻¹·s) → θ(x)·∫_Q f dμ = θ′(ρ • x)·∫_Q f dμ, for every f.

5. The seven fields of IsRectifiableTriple univ k M′ θ′ ξ′.
(i) subset: M′ ⊆ univ.
(ii) nullMeasurableSet: B := toMeasurable μ M is measurable and B =ᵐ[μ] M (NullMeasurableSet.toMeasurable_ae_eq, ae_eq_set). φ(B) is measurable (MeasurableEmbedding.measurableSet_image). By injectivity, φ(B) ∖ φ(M) = φ(B ∖ M) and φ(M) ∖ φ(B) = φ(M ∖ B) (Set.image_sdiff), and both are μ-null by 0(a). Hence φ(B) =ᵐ φ(M), and φ(M) is null measurable (NullMeasurableSet.congr).
(iii) countablyRectifiable: CountablyRectifiable k M gives M₀ with μ(M₀) = 0 and maps F_j : ℝ^k → ℝ^N with LipschitzWith K_j (F_j) and M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j range F_j.
- φ is LipschitzWith ‖ρ‖₊, since dist(ρ • a, ρ • b) = ‖ρ‖·dist(a, b) (dist_smul₀).
- Take φ(M₀), which is μ-null by 0(a), and φ ∘ F_j, which is LipschitzWith (‖ρ‖₊·K_j) (LipschitzWith.comp).
- If y = φ(x) with x ∈ M, then either x ∈ M₀ and y ∈ φ(M₀), or x = F_j(w) and y = (φ ∘ F_j)(w). So M′ ⊆ φ(M₀) ∪ ⋃_j range(φ ∘ F_j).
(iv) pos: θ′(φ x) = θ(x) > 0 for x ∈ M, by (★).
(v) integrableOn: let K ⊆ univ be compact.
- M′ ∩ K = φ(M ∩ φ⁻¹(K)) (Set.image_inter_preimage), and φ⁻¹(K) is compact (Homeomorph.isCompact_preimage for Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero ρ).
- By 0(c) and (★) (θ′ ∘ φ = θ), θ′ is μ-integrable on φ(M ∩ φ⁻¹(K)) iff θ is (c·μ)-integrable on M ∩ φ⁻¹(K).
- The latter holds: θ is μ-integrable on M ∩ φ⁻¹(K) by the triple's integrableOn field at the compact set φ⁻¹(K), and c ≠ ∞ (Integrable.smul_measure, ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).
(vi) aestronglyMeasurable: by 0(d), μ|_{M′} = φ_#(c·(μ|_M)). For the measurable embedding φ, ξ′ is AE strongly measurable for φ_#ν iff ξ′ ∘ φ = ξ is AE strongly measurable for ν (MeasurableEmbedding.aestronglyMeasurable_map_iff). ξ is AE strongly measurable for μ|_M by the triple, hence for c·(μ|_M) (AEStronglyMeasurable.smul_measure).
(vii) orients: by 0(d) and MeasurableEmbedding.ae_map_iff, ‘for μ|_{M′}-a.e. y, P(y)’ is equivalent to ‘for c·(μ|_M)-a.e. x, P(φ x)’.
- The triple's orients field gives, for μ|_M-a.e. x, hence for c·(μ|_M)-a.e. x (Measure.ae_smul_measure), an orthonormal τ : Fin k → ℝ^N with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M θ x (span(range τ)) and ξ(x) = simpleNVector τ or ξ(x) = −simpleNVector τ.
- For such x the same τ works at φ x: HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M′ θ′ (ρ • x) (span(range τ)) by step 4, and ξ′(φ x) = ξ(x) = ±simpleNVector τ by (★).

6. Conclusion. By steps 5, 3 and 2, (M′, θ′, ξ′) is a rectifiable triple in univ, θ′ is natural-valued on M′, and Y(ω) = tauAction k M′ θ′ ξ′ ω for every test ω. Hence IsIntegerMultiplicity Y. ∎

τ change of variables: tauAction k M θ ξ (ρ^kω(ρ·)) = tauAction k (ρM) θ(ρ⁻¹·) ξ(ρ⁻¹·) ω. With the sibling pull-back test form, this gives Y = τ(ρM, θ′, ξ′).
Blow-ups: blowUpMap (ρx) s '' ρM = blowUpMap x (ρ⁻¹s) '' M and θ′(ρx + su) = θ(x + ρ⁻¹su). Since s ↦ ρ⁻¹s preserves 𝓝[>]0, weighted approximate tangent planes transfer.
